content.bridge_context: Introduction to the banking system and financial literacy.

units.title: What is a Bank?
units.explanation: An institution where people save money and take loans.
units.dual_language_instruction: Have you ever visited a bank? / क्या आप कभी बैंक गए हैं?

units.title: Savings and Interest
units.explanation: Saving money in a bank earns interest. Borrowing money from a bank costs interest.
units.dual_language_instruction: What is an ATM? / ATM क्या है?
